next_actions.pass: Record individual identity component qualification only. Continue group/side conversation/closure and separate guarded household memory integration qualification before product acceptance.
next_actions.fail: Preserve once-scored heldout outcome, keep recognition unqualified, diagnose quality/model/acoustic limitations prospectively; no threshold retuning on these labels.
next_actions.error: Stop microphone and owned work; preserve earlier examples, retry exact local save or resume with fresh consent. No cloud fallback.
next_actions.needs_evidence: Wait for voluntary human voices and independent adult review through the complete in-app flow; no agent microphone or fabricated consent.

hypothesis: One frozen development-only cosine and separation rule meets the original individual identity sub-screen on separately reviewed heldout local recordings, without accepting full group interaction or household memory.

configuration.inputs: At evaluation the exact reviewed rows, profile files and development policy are private hash-bound inputs before decisions. Model files and decision/evaluation source code also frozen. No thresholds adjusted on heldout.
configuration.coverage: Four enrolled people with >=25eligible2-5s utterances each, >=20unknown, >=20short+overlap with both present. All enrollment, historical enrollment reuse and development sessions/PCM excluded. Unknown decisions count against known accuracy; all attempted/ineligible rows retained.
configuration.gates: Known >=90%overall and>=85%each; confident wrong known <=1%; unknown rejection>=95%; zero hypothetical uncertain/overlap personal memory authorization. Similarity is not probability. Unknown/overlap truth labels are never classifier inputs.
configuration.limits: A single scored evaluation for this frozen configuration. A failure is preserved and does not authorize retuning on those labels or automatic repeat. Group followups/side conversations/closure, E4 and E5 acceptance remain open.
